title: The contents stage's answer
description: Each entry of a book's printed table of contents, in the order it prints them. The store keeps it whole as the output's answer, and serve places each entry on a PDF page and writes the book's contents sections from them. An empty list says the pages held no contents.

title.description: The entry's title as the contents prints it, with its number.

page.description: The page number printed beside the entry, as printed, or null where none is.

level.description: 1 for the outermost entries, 2 for those under them, and so on.
